summary_en: 40,000 shares (0.7% S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-20 at ¥606/share ceiling; total outlay ¥24.24M; execution limited to single trading session open-market block placement.
summary_jp: ToSTNeT-3にて2026-08-20に40,000株（発行済0.7%）を買付；買付上限価額は2026-08-19終値606円；総額¥24.24M；当該取引時間限りの注文。
